authority: Manuscript Sections II-VIII and SPEC-001-004 only
integration_decision: Proceed with bounded recovery-admission reference work; do not deploy restart/replica services

unsafe_restart_negative_controls.observation: A stale trusted-bootstrap counter reassigns rid 42 although the authentic signed public root is unchanged
unsafe_restart_negative_controls.classification: Unsupported stale bootstrap violates existing trusted-checkpoint assumption; restart-admission gap

unsafe_restart_negative_controls.observation: A stale pending challenge reconstructed without its consumed tombstone accepts a second time in the deliberately unsynchronised store
unsafe_restart_negative_controls.classification: Unsupported rollback violates shared atomic store assumption; restart-admission gap

other_recovery_gaps: Manager checkpoint constructor does not restore earlier public update history
IssuerSnapshot omits complete pending challenge/controller data and is not a restart image
ControllerSnapshot omits salt and private signer handles; pending record alone cannot restore controller ownership
Interrupted claimed issuer sessions have no supported administrative retirement/recovery API
Holder credential/witness pair can be authentic at an old root and still unusable for a fresh challenge
No checkpoint import/admission or external rollback authority is implemented
local_invariants: Supported live-state faults preserve permanent reservations, certification logs, whole holder pairs and at-most-once consumption
coordination: Independent ordered DID and revocation reads are not one cross-service transaction
privacy: Public verifier receives only context/session/D/mD/opaque proof; anonymous processing performs no holder DID/controller lookup
guard: Unchanged cgroup-v2 268435456 bytes, zero swap, one worker; config.json
next_scope: Bounded typed recovery/checkpoint validation and fail-closed activation with an explicitly specified injected recovery authority; no storage engine/proofs
trust_decision_open: Which independently trusted authority establishes checkpoint completeness and freshness after rollback; no policy silently adopted
